messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 7):
"""
I also undertake that, Insurer shall: i) maintain the entire set of documents required under U&F Procedure and shall submit the documents to the IRDAI, as and when required, within two days ii) not modify without completing the due process mandated for modifications iii) put in place appropriate systems, procedures, manuals, all essential infrastructure required for launching the product and maintenance of insurance policies iv) upload all the required documents of the product on the website Signed by Chief Executive Officer Name: Date: FORMS FOR PRODUCT FILING Annexure - 3 FORM FOR FILING HEALTH INSURANCE PRODUCTS/ADD-ON OFFERED, WITH PMC, BY LIFE, HEALTH AND GENERAL INSURERS 1. Description of Use and File Procedure - (a) An insurer, who wishes to introduce a new product/modification of existing product, shall file the form IRDAI-HIP annexed herewith.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"How quickly must an insurer submit the required documents to IRDAI after a product modification request?","answer":"Within two days of the request.","facts":["within two days"]},{"question":"What must an insurer do before modifying an existing health insurance product?","answer":"Complete the due process mandated for modifications.","facts":["not modify without completing the due process mandated for modifications"]}]}
